Hey! Have a Rest Card? Let me show you how to use it and give your lowest-step day a boost!

Step 1. Head to Power Cards

and select your Rest Card.

Step 2. Check your potential impact. I'll show you how your step count, contest deficit and club placement could change after applying the card.

Step 3. Happy with the impact? Tap Apply Rest Card.

Before applying, I'll check whether this card will make a meaningful difference to your progress. If the benefit is low, I'll let you know, and you can choose whether to apply it or save it for later.

If there's no benefit, you can save your card for another time.

Step 4. If you proceed, I'll automatically scan your contest history, find your lowest eligible step day and apply the card to it. You don't have to search for or select the day yourself!

And that's it! Your lowest day gets a boost, your total contest steps increase and your deficit comes down. Easy, right?

Now get back out there and keep building that consistency. I'll be right here cheering you on!
